notes: PPO is deterministic; any supplied policy_seed is ignored.

metric_definitions.cumulative_resistance_burden: Negative of the simulator's cumulative reward (ml.src.matched_policy_evaluation._episode_burden): sum over steps of resistant_count_after / 7, with an all-resistant state charged for the remaining horizon. Lower means less simulated resistance burden; it is not a clinical outcome.
metric_definitions.cumulative_reward: Sum of simulator step rewards plus any terminal adjustment (ml.src.metrics).
metric_definitions.treatment_steps: Number of actions taken before the episode ended.
metric_definitions.initial_resistant_count: Resistant antibiotics in the initial profile.
metric_definitions.final_resistant_count: Resistant antibiotics in the final profile.
metric_definitions.final_susceptible_count: Susceptible antibiotics in the final profile (ml.src.metrics future_effective_antibiotics).
metric_definitions.change_in_susceptible_count: final_susceptible_count minus the initial susceptible count.
metric_definitions.resistance_emergence_events: Steps after which the resistant count increased (ml.src.metrics).
metric_definitions.resistance_emergence_rate: resistance_emergence_events / treatment_steps; null when there are no steps.
metric_definitions.susceptible_action_rate: Fraction of steps whose selected drug was susceptible in the simulator (ml.src.metrics treatment_effectiveness_rate). The susceptible-only mask makes this 1.0 for all strategies, and it is not clinical efficacy; null when there are no steps.
metric_definitions.unsupported_step_count: Steps with transition_status unsupported_no_candidate: the simulator had no candidate transition and left the profile unchanged.
metric_definitions.cumulative_antibiotic_exposure: Number of antibiotic administrations (one per step).

disclaimer: Simulation output only. It is not clinical advice, a validated treatment recommendation, or a statement about clinical efficacy.
